key.description: Area identifier. Unique within the project.

leadAgentId.description: The area's lead — its only external contact.

maxParallel.description: How many agents the lead can have in the SESSION without requesting authorization. Above that, a `proposed_action`. The cap is per session, not per module: counting per module would allow N modules × N agents with no authorization at all.

members.description: The members. In the dev area they come from the `module_map`, one per module — that is what keeps the area from being a fixed list in code.

401.description: No token, expired token, or invalid signature.

404.description: Project, session, or task not found.

429.description: Rate limit per user or per IP.
